condition.input: all train input/output grids and one test input grid; no task identifier or derived features
condition.output: one JSON object with attempt_1 grid and attempt_2 grid or null

offline_policy: No network, web search, external ARC data, semantic oracle, test target, capability library, compiler, executor, verifier, or search during inference.
prediction_protocol: complete all task predictions, validate completeness, SHA256-freeze artifact, then and only then load local development test targets for exact scoring
